note: Kentucky State Parks campground on a wooded hill above the Licking River at the site of the 1782 Battle of Blue Licks, near Carlisle; the loop sits uphill off US-68 with no river access from camp. The pedestals stand well back from the pads: bring a second water hose and a 50-ft extension cord. Lodge restaurant, museum, pool and mini golf in the park. --Claude
